name: Tsuruga
text: Tsuruga (敦賀市, Tsuruga-shi) is a city located in Fukui Prefecture, Japan. As of June 29, 2018, the city had an estimated population of 66,123 in 28,604 households and the population density of 260 persons per km2. The total area of the city was  251.39 square kilometers (97.06 sq mi).

depictions.name: Tsuruga
depictions.text: Tsuruga, Fukui Tsuruga is a city in Fukui Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated in Sotomo Gate in the Wakasa province.
